Name: Auto spacing for sprinklers
Author: AstralFSK
Description:
I'm kinda tired of placing sprinkler one by one, so here we are !

Ok, about the usage:

- Pressing:
   + Up arrow will add 1 row to the preview.
   + Down arrow will remove 1 row from the preview.
   + Left arrow will remove 1 column from the preview.
   + Right arrow will add 1 column to the preview.

-After that, left click to place the sprinklers, they will be auto-spaced out to cover all of the preview tiles, or until no sprinkler left.
-You can choose to also attach nozzle to sprinklers by pressing left control (The video is obsolete for this part).

-Placement order will be [s]bottom to top, left to right [/s]left to right and top to bottom.

-Auto Toggle Placement Preview (My other mod) is required, minimum ver 1.4.0
